svg.title: BiLSTM Sequential architecture for text classification
svg.desc: Sequential model: Embedding with pretrained weights → SpatialDropout1D → Bidirectional LSTM returning sequences → GlobalAveragePooling1D → Dropout → Dense sigmoid output.

g.onclick: sendPrompt('What is the role of pretrained embedding weights in BiLSTM training?')
sendPrompt('How is SpatialDropout1D different from regular Dropout for sequences?')
sendPrompt('Why use return_sequences=True in the BiLSTM layer?')
sendPrompt('Why is GlobalAveragePooling1D described as a simple attention mechanism?')
g.text: averages hidden states across all timesteps

g.onclick: sendPrompt('Why is a second Dropout layer placed after pooling?')
sendPrompt('Why binary cross-entropy with sigmoid output for toxicity detection?')
sendPrompt('What does the final output probability represent?')

svg.text: Bidirectional LSTM · Sequential API · gradient clipping stabilises training
